Hi! I would like to make a request for my OC. Feel free to draw whatever outfit and pose you want. Thank you very much!

Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fj_gKGB1BEQiz-fdBSb1gVaoubdD1C0m?usp=sharing

Good day,

I would like an illustration of a Vtuber friend of mine in your art style.

Her name is Illumi

CHARACTER DETAILS
- Is a Cat demon girl
- has 2 cat tails
- has car ears and glowing demon horns
- chest size is DD cup
- has a hairpin that changes expressions to match her expressions
- personality is unhinged and creative, Likes to post memes all day and ask questions about life
- likes Drawing art, nintendo games, persona (games), SMT (ATLUS), Monster Hunter, Cats and streaming,


Please feel free to pose her however you like!

Thank you.
